title: Read an email like a detective
description: A phishing email may copy a brand, but its sender address, link, or request can reveal the trick. Check the details before you click.
example: “Delivery failed. Pay $1.95 at parcel-help.example to reschedule.” If you did not expect a package, check the carrier directly.

questions.prompt: A delivery email asks for a small fee. What is the safest check?
questions.explanation: Open a trusted app or type the known address yourself. Do not rely on the message link.

questions.prompt: Which detail can expose an impersonator?
questions.explanation: A familiar design is easy to copy. Inspect the actual sender address.

questions.prompt: The email asks you to download an unexpected invoice. What now?
answers: Verify with the sender another way
questions.explanation: Unexpected attachments can be harmful. Contact the sender through a known channel.
